field.name: active_mode
field.comment: The current active mode

field.name: active_submode
field.comment: The current active submode

field.name: mode_error
field.comment: The error mode bit. If asserted then error_flags contains the current error map

field.name: mode_status
field.comment: The current mode’s status

field.name: error_flags
field.comment: A bitmap of all the possible errors

field.name: motor_rpm
field.comment: Motor revolutions per minute

field.name: has_package
field.comment: A flag that indicates if a package is sensed on the wire

field.name: instant_weight
field.comment: The wait of the package in kg. Relevant when has_package = 1

field.name: net_state
field.comment: A flag that indicates the net status

field.name: lock_state
field.comment: The state of the lock servo

field.name: mode_duration
field.comment: Time in milliseconds in the current mode

field.name: motor_temperature
field.comment: The current temperature of the motor

field.name: spool_input_max_lag
field.comment: The distance (in meters) that the actual wire position is permitted to fall behind the target position before the controller triggers an error

field.name: spool_input_max_lag_window
field.comment: The maximum time (e.g., 0.5 seconds) the controller will wait for the spool to reach a commanded position

field.name: spool_input_max_overshoot
field.comment: The difference between the peak physical position reached by the spool and the final steady-state setpoint

field.name: spool_input_max_overshoot_window
field.comment: The time window which allows spool/unspool overshoot

field.name: spool_input_min_speed
field.comment: The lowest linear velocity at which the wire is permitted to travel while the system is in an active "run" state

field.name: spool_input_min_speed_window
field.comment: The maximum duration the system allows for the motor to reach or maintain its "Min Speed" threshold

field.name: spool_input_load_acc
field.comment: The rate of change of the angular velocity of the rotating spool drum (measured in rad/s²)

field.name: spool_input_load_dec
field.comment: The rate at which the angular velocity of the spool drum decreases (measured in rad/s²)

field.name: spool_input_req_exec_hold
field.comment: A flag for executing/stopping the current action

field.name: spool_input_target_ext
field.comment: The desired total length of cable to be deployed or unwound

field.name: spool_input_home_switch_activated
field.comment: The endswitch which is triggered when the bobbin is in the house

field.name: spool_input_max_force
field.comment: The maximum allowable cable tension or linear pulling force the system can exert

field.name: spool_input_min_force
field.comment: The minimum amount of tension or pulling effort that must be maintained on the wire to ensure safe and reliable operation

field.name: spool_input_max_torque
field.comment: The software or hardware limit on the rotational twisting force the motor can apply to the spool shaft

field.name: spool_input_min_torque
field.comment: The lower threshold of rotational force that the motor is commanded or allowed to maintain

field.name: spool_input_energize
field.comment: Energizing the motor

field.name: spool_internal_energize_allowed
field.comment: AND (spool_input_energize, spool_input_encoder_reliable)

field.name: spool_internal_ext_setpoint
field.comment: The target value for the length of wire that comes out from the trajectory generator

field.name: spool_internal_ext_err
field.comment: The difference between where the wire should be and where it actually is (spool_internal_ext_setpoint - spool_output_ext)

field.name: spool_internal_shaft_setpoint
field.comment: The target angular position for the motor's output shaft

field.name: spool_internal_shaft_err
field.comment: The difference between where the shaft should be and where it actually is (spool_internal_shaft_setpoint - spool_output_shaft_pos)

field.name: spool_internal_quad_current_req
field.comment: The value for the specific component of motor current that is responsible for generating torque

field.name: spool_internal_quad_current_active_setpoint
field.comment: The final, safety-filtered command for torque-producing current (𝐼𝑞) that is actually sent to the motor's power electronics

field.name: spool_output_trajectory_margin
field.comment: The maximum allowable physical distance the system can deviate from its pre-planned motion path

field.name: spool_output_target_reached
field.comment: A flag which indicates if the wire reached target

field.name: spool_output_go_emergency_hold
field.comment: A flag which controls if the spooling enters emergency hold or continue with operation

field.name: spool_output_executing_holding
field.comment: OR (spool_output_go_emergency_hold, spool_input_req_exec_hold)

field.name: spool_output_shaft_load_ctrl
field.comment: AND(spool_input_req_shaft_ctrl_load, spool_output_homing_complete)

field.name: spool_output_ext
field.comment: The output wire extension in meters

field.name: spool_output_shaft_pos
field.comment: The output shaft position in radian

field.name: spool_output_homing_complete
field.comment: “WIRE_HOMING” mode is complete

field.name: spool_output_force
field.comment: The real-time linear pulling effort currently being exerted by the cable (in N)

field.name: spool_output_torque
field.comment: The rotational twisting force currently being generated at the motor's output shaft (in Nm)

field.name: spool_output_bobbin_speed
field.comment: Bobbin speed, rad/s

field.name: spool_output_load_speed
field.comment: Load speed, m/s

field.name: spool_output_total_energy_cntr
field.comment: Total energy counter, J

field.name: spool_output_alignment_complete
field.comment: Alignment complete flag
